owner_steps: The owner has the device in hand, unlocked, trusted and charged; the automation build is installed by the campaign (signing is the owner's).
The owner taps and drags stars, taps the gauges and orbits with two fingers; the campaign does not synthesise touches on hardware.
rows.pass: Touch-to-frame latency recorded for 200 samples per device; a tap under 10 points and 0.5 s on a star while playing nudges it once and chooses it; a drag of 16 points or more from a star previews the filament and, released within 22 points of another star, links the pair exactly once (or unlinks a pair the player linked); a tap on a gauge while playing sends exactly one listen; a double tap on empty space restores the authored camera.
rows.procedure: Tap a star to nudge it, drag from one star to another to link them (and back over a player link to unlink it), tap the coherence or hold gauge to listen, orbit the camera with two fingers and double-tap empty space on each device; the campaign records the interval from touch to the first frame showing the change.
rows.title: Touch feel and touch-to-frame latency

rows.pass: The sound is audible only while it is on, the panel is shown and the scene is active, and follows the silent switch; each planned haptic is felt (where the device has no haptic engine, the haptic part is recorded as not applicable).
rows.procedure: Turn the Sound toggle on and play a level to a win and to a failure with the haptics switch on, including one refused action (a link the rules refuse, such as one beyond a star's degree limit); inspect a link to hear its audition; observe the constellation's ambient sound and the selection, success, warning and error haptics.
rows.title: Sound heard and haptics felt
